items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: he had Otto Hardwick, he went up to the Cotton Club... Harry Carney and Hardwicke was basic

ctx.x: And that was a trio. Duke Ellington on piano, Sonny Greer on drums and Elmer Snowden on banjo.
Yeah, and then the first thing I know Duke got together with -- he had Otto Hardwick, he went up to the Cotton Club, see, and that was a great year. He stayed up there five years from '27 to '32.
Otto Hardwick played saxophone didn't he. From 1927 --
